name: Account Research
tagline: Actionable sales intel on any company or person before outreach — researched live in the agent's browser, scored against your ICP.
who: Founders and reps who want their best-rep-quality research on a prospect — or an honest "don't pursue" — before a call or a sequence.
how: Say "research <company>" and the agent works its browser: site, news, funding, careers, LinkedIn, competitive footprint. It reads your GTM brain first so the research is calibrated to your ICP and pains, not generic. One account returns a research doc with a quick take, trigger events, key people with talking points, qualification signals, and a recommended approach with discovery questions. A CSV of accounts fans out to helper agents and returns one sheet, a row per account with a fit verdict — including the accounts to walk away from.
